targets.rawSql: SELECT advice_id, agent, ticker, direction, fill_px AS entry_px, target_band[0] AS target_low, target_band[1] AS target_high, stop_loss, opened_at, unrealized_pnl_usd FROM lake.backtest_positions WHERE state = 'open' ORDER BY opened_at DESC
SELECT closed_at, agent, ticker, direction, exit_reason, pnl_r, pnl_usd FROM lake.backtest_positions WHERE state = 'closed' ORDER BY closed_at DESC LIMIT 50
